node.statement: Admissible setup from the registered dependencies: in the finite-dimensional raw-factor setting, let 0 <= eta <= rho_id^corr = min{rho_theta,rho_AI,epsilon_E/C_A}. Since rho_theta=1/8, eta<1/4, so lem-kitaev-almost-idemp-audit gives tilde-Phi^2=tilde-Phi and A=Im(tilde-Phi). By lem-routef-ai-defect-linearization, A is an extended epsilon_AI(eta)-C*-algebra with epsilon_AI(eta) <= C_A*eta; the radius gives eta <= rho_AI and C_A*eta <= epsilon_E. Hence lem-thmainext-conditional supplies a finite-dimensional C*-algebra B and an extended C_E*epsilon_AI(eta)-isomorphism v:B->A. By def-extended-delta-inclusion, v is bijective (in particular onto A), so v^(-1):A->B exists.
